art.classification: GENERATIVE/PRESENTATION SUPPORT; no body/world truth authority

findings.claim: NeRD Physics implements a deterministic/simulated avatar state with joints, torques, contacts, rooms and analytical/neural dynamics. Mood and coherence are upstream inputs to the simulator: mood changes gravity multiplier, damping and walk speed; coherence changes joint-noise magnitude. sensation.py then converts contacts/torques/kinematics into a [BODY PHYSICS] natural-language block and also conditions wording directly on mood.
findings.implication: This is a valid functional digital-body feedback mechanism but not independent body-state evidence. Any downstream correlation between mood, physical sensation text and model self-report is partly designed by construction and must be tested with mood-shuffle/cut and physics-lesion controls.
findings.required_oracle: Harness must distinguish physical backing state -> percept/sensation transformation -> language interpretation, and run matched controls where mood/coherence inputs are shuffled or severed.

findings.claim: The simulator encodes named rooms (e.g. Archive, Engine Room, Observation Deck, Workshop, AURA Chamber) as bounded 3D boxes with gravity/surface/object/contact parameters and waypoint navigation. These names are interface/world metaphors over deterministic geometry and collision rules.
findings.implication: Reuse room geometry/contact/transition semantics as world-model test fixtures if useful, but never inherit literal historical room names/AURA chambers as current FRANK ontology.

findings.claim: Sanctum RL behavior is explicitly reward-shaped. The environment rewards new locations (+2 in current step implementation), first silence (+3), optimal exit (+8), diverse terminal/experiment actions and applies revisit/repetition/time/premature-exit penalties; time pressure increases after 25/35/45 minutes. rewards.py separately documents the intended shaping constants, some of which differ from the current environment literals.
findings.implication: Historical claims that the policy learned preferred session length, exploration, silence or exit timing are evidence of optimization under this reward function, not spontaneous desire/agency. Reward-code/version identity must accompany every behavioral interpretation.
findings.required_oracle: Ablate/reweight reward terms and report policy behavior sensitivity; never infer intrinsic goals from a target behavior that is directly rewarded.

findings.claim: Even after entity variables were disabled/removed, historical world/policy code retains semantic residues such as entity_lounge/AURA-related locations and Quantum Reflector variable documentation. QUBOBuilder explicitly notes AURA reverse integration is disabled because AURA was replaced by Swarm and the old endpoint generated repeated 404s.
findings.implication: Treat these labels as temporal lineage/supersession evidence. Current FRANK/Clay architecture must use current typed subsystem identities rather than importing historical metaphor names from simulations.

findings.claim: Quantum Reflector constructs a 39-variable binary quadratic objective from FRANK state and compares current encoded energy with an annealed best state. CoherenceMonitor defines the gap as best_energy - current_energy and tracks trend/violations. The inspected code is a classical QUBO/annealing state optimizer/readout; its name does not establish quantum computation or consciousness.
findings.implication: Reuse objective/constraint/differential-state techniques only under explicit mathematical semantics. Do not promote 'quantum', 'coherence' or low energy as consciousness evidence.

findings.claim: room_content literature/philosophy/procedural-space and art modules/assets supply environmental/presentation content. space_generator.py is a procedural visual generator ported from a Godot shader pipeline; external_assets contains terminal GUI, gallery, portraits, journal, books, workshop and instrument media trees.
findings.implication: Classify these as content/UI/environment backing unless a specific executable causal path into cognition is separately demonstrated. Media volume does not count as mechanism evidence or earned work.
